intent.outcome: The Formulae panel shows a Catppuccin-styled 4-column table (Name, Version, Status, Tap) with an underline tab bar at the top of the main pane. Outdated formulae appear first, then pinned, then alphabetical. Other panels keep their current rendering.

problem.description: Currently the Formulae panel renders either a single-formula Info view or a plain-text list. There is no tabular presentation, no visual prioritization of outdated packages, and the tab bar lives at the bottom of the sidebar (not at the top of the main pane where modern TUIs put it). The result feels clunky and empty.

in_scope: Add a 'List' tab to the Formulae panel as tab 0 (table view), shifting the existing Info/Deps/Files/Used-by tabs to positions 1-4.
Render the formulae list as a 4-column table: Name | Version | Status | Tap.
Version column shows 'oldver -> newver' (e.g. '1.7.1 -> 1.7.2') for outdated formulae, just the version for installed/pinned.
Tap column shows shortened tap origin (e.g. 'hb/c' for homebrew/core).
Default sort: Outdated first, then Pinned, then alphabetical by name.
Empty state when 0 formulae: centered 'No formulae yet' + 'Press / to search & install' hint.
Move tab bar from bottom-of-sidebar to top of main pane (just below the breadcrumb).
Apply underline-tab style: active tab = bold + thick bottom border (lipgloss.ThickBorder bottom or equivalent); inactive tabs = dimmed text, no border.
Add tests: tab bar renders at top of main pane, formulae table renders with correct columns and sort, empty state shows hint, snapshot tests for tab bar and table rendering.
out_of_scope: Tables for Casks, Outdated, Taps, Services, Status, Search panels (deferred to M17 roll-out).
Column-width auto-sizing across panels (compute per panel; only Formulae in M16).
In-tab filtering (e.g. type to filter formulae) — separate decision.
Multi-column sort or custom sort orders (always outdated>pinned>alpha in M16).
Light theme adjustments (theme inherits from M14's Mocha; light theme still unchanged).

design_decisions.choice: Move tab bar from sidebar-bottom to top of main pane
design_decisions.rationale: Modern TUI pattern (lazygit, btop, k9s). Tab bar attached to content makes the 'active tab' visual relationship obvious. Sidebar-bottom tabs feel detached.

design_decisions.choice: List (table) is tab 0; existing Info/Deps/Files/Used-by shift to 1-4
design_decisions.rationale: User picked preview that shows the table at top with existing tabs above. List is the most useful default view; Info is detail-on-demand.

design_decisions.choice: 4 columns: Name | Version | Status | Tap (no source path column to keep widths manageable in narrow panes)
design_decisions.rationale: All 4 columns meaningful; Tap origin useful for spotting custom-tap formulae. Source path kept in Info detail tab instead.

design_decisions.choice: Outdated > Pinned > Alphabetical (default, no user override in M16)
design_decisions.rationale: Action-first view: see what needs updating immediately. Pinned next since they're often intentionally held. Alpha for the rest. No sort toggle yet — defer to M17.
